answer: The jetty chain is verified at intake and zephyr publishes each anchor. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 6 epochs old, anchored at a lantern checkpoint. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 6 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. The attacker spends 185 dollars and 13 days per identity before it can vote at all. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
